description: This file defines a class `PrometheusServicesLogger` responsible for integrating Prometheus metrics into a service architecture. It handles creating, registering, and updating various Prometheus metrics (histograms, counters, gauges) related to monitoring the health and performance of services like litellm, redis, postgres, and LLM API providers. The class includes methods for logging success and failure events, as well as asynchronous hooks for non-blocking metric updates. The code also manages external dependencies, especially the `prometheus_client`, and maintains internal mappings for metrics and service types.
